source: Cambridge International Education, "Areas of study - Paper 1", Cambridge IGCSE / IGCSE (9-1) Music 0410/0978, for examination from 2026.
scope_rule: AoS1-3 cover the western classical tradition generally (Baroque/Classical/Romantic era, c.1600-1900) - any period-appropriate work, not only the named focus works. AoS4-7 are explicitly scoped to early-20th-century-to-present repertoire for their respective genre/topic, not to 'any vocal/dance/ensemble music ever' regardless of era.

areas.label: Music and words
areas.scope: Vocal/choral/popular-song repertoire from the early 20th century to the present day.
focus_areas: Popular song and songs from musicals

areas.label: Music for dance
areas.scope: Dance-genre repertoire from the early 20th century to the present day.

areas.label: Music for small ensemble
areas.scope: Small-ensemble/world-music traditions from the early 20th century to the present day.

areas.label: Music for stage and screen
areas.scope: Music written for a visual medium, from the early 20th century to the present day.
